## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`...)

- [ ] Docs updated (README, guides) and an ADR added if a significant decision was made
- [ ] No secrets, no real personal data, no brand assets
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording for UI changes
